content:
I'm in the process of updating our Waterproof Verso genre from v4.20.0. (To at least 4.25.0, since that's the latest tag of Verbose Lean).

The issue arising is that in between the upgrade from v4.20.0 to v4.21.0, the goals disappear. If I move from #doc to #old_doc, it does work. Since that was introduced in this incrementality PR, I'm guessing this is the reason. Demo file here, which is broken by changing old_docs back to doc (branch: version-bump-isolation). Note that the Genre itself also turns on our goal widget, but the disappearance of goals happens regardless of whether the widget is enabled.

@David Thrane Christiansen, do you have any helpful thoughts?:)
@Pim Otte , can you maybe try backporting this and seeing if it helps?
Indeed, I just bumped your code to the latest Verso main (which incorporates the bug fix that @Emilio Jesús Gallego Arias linked to) and the problem goes away.
Want me to send a bump PR, to avoid duplication of effort?

I'll be happy to help with the backport if you want, even better, if easy, just go ahead and try to bump toolchain / verso to v4.29-rc3 . There are a few more LSP fixes and improvements in the queue that could be relevant for you folks (folding, outline)

https://github.com/impermeable/waterproof-genre/pull/3 fixes the problem on top of your MWE commit by updating to a new Verso (and thus Lean). I merged in main as a separate merge commit so you could decide how you wanted to handle the specifics.

David Thrane Christiansen said:

Want me to send a bump PR, to avoid duplication of effort?

That would be great!

Let's not backport this, since v4.25.0 won't fix this issue, I'd rather put some work in updating Verbose Lean instead to get to a stable point for everything.
